meta.title: Thoughtful stationery for everyday things
meta.description: From daycare cubbies to school desks, kids have a lot of stuff and somehow, it always finds a way to get lost. Our personalized labels help keep their everyday essentials easy to identify.

hero.intro: Personalized name labels made to help keep your little one's everyday essentials organized; from daycare and school to water bottles, lunch boxes, and everything in between.

shop.note: A small edit of paper goods designed to make the everyday feel a little more intentional.

about.body: subzeecreations is a one-person studio in Mississauga, Canada. Every piece is designed, packed, and sent from my little corner to all over the world.
